scenario: LOPQ.3.3 — interpolating an opaque value into a string would leak its raw representation, so it is sealed: DS_VALIDATE_OPAQUE_NO_OP.
rules_ds:
opaque type Key over Bytes

schema A scope logical:
    id: String key
    k: Key mutable

rule r:
    A a where a.id == "x"
->
    log info "key is {a.k}"
